title: I asked AI to predict the next crypto to 100x

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the next 100x crypto isn't built on hype, but on real-world utility and breakthrough tech?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Smart contracts on Layer 2s and zero-knowledge proofs are enabling privacy and scalability we’ve never seen before.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if we prioritize profit over people, we risk deepening inequality and enabling financial crime at scale.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on regulation-compliant frameworks and transparent governance models to mitigate those risks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where blockchain empowers the unbanked and fuels global innovation, not just speculation.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of crypto lies in balancing innovation with responsibility — the next 100x may come from that balance.

video_cue: A montage of diverse people using blockchain-based apps for education, healthcare, and small business growth.
